source.manualTitle: LG LMHM2237BD Over-the-Range Microwave Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power and discharge HV
steps.body: Unplug the microwave or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge the high-voltage capacitor before touching any HV component. Never operate the unit with interlock switches bypassed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DISCONNECT THE POWER SUPPLY CORD FROM THE OUTLET WHENEVER REMOVING THE OUTER CASE.

steps.title: Continue after self-test entry
steps.body: Self-test mode entered (Defrost weight/time 2 sec → TEST). Continue with fault interpretation below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: §6-3 Self diagnosis — humidity sensor and PCB thermistor check.

steps.title: Service test result for thermistor?
steps.body: Enter service test (Defrost weight/time 2 sec → TEST). Unit checks PCB thermistor and humidity sensor. Did display show F-1 (thermistor short) or F-2 (thermistor open)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: F-1 PCB thermistor short; F-2 PCB thermistor open.

steps.title: Thermistor path verified
steps.body: Service test PASS — PCB thermistor circuit normal.
steps.oemOutcome: Service test PASS — PCB thermistor circuit normal.

steps.title: Cabinet thermistor harness OK?
steps.body: Inspect cabinet thermistor and harness at PCB. Repair open/shorted harness if found.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect cabinet thermistor and harness at PCB. Repair open/shorted harness if found.

steps.title: Repair thermistor harness
steps.body: Repair or replace thermistor harness and retest service mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair or replace thermistor harness and retest service mode.

steps.title: Replace thermistor or PCB
steps.body: Replace cabinet thermistor or main PCB (EBR75341201) per fault.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace cabinet thermistor or main PCB (EBR75341201) per fault.
